user.title: Nextcloud Memories
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to your Nextcloud Memories instance. The two URL fields serve different purposes: Nextcloud supplies photos, while Home Assistant serves prepared photos to the ESP32.

data_description.base_url: Address of your Nextcloud server as reached from Home Assistant. Enter its base address without /apps/memories.
data_description.username: Nextcloud user with access to the albums you want to display.
data_description.api_token: Prefer a Nextcloud app password/token instead of your main account password.
data_description.verify_ssl: Check the server's HTTPS certificate. Disable only if you understand the security implications.
data_description.image_base_url: Address of Home Assistant reachable from the ESP32 on your network. The frame downloads processed photos from this address, not from Nextcloud.

abort.already_configured: This Nextcloud URL is already configured

init.title: Frame devices
init.description: Choose an action for your picture frames. Existing frames: {devices}

data_description.image_base_url: Home Assistant URL accessible from the ESP32. Change it if frames cannot download their prepared photos.
data_description.action: Create a frame, edit an existing frame, or remove a frame configuration.
data_description.target_device_key: Select the existing frame you want to edit or delete. This field appears only for those actions.

device.title: Frame settings
device.description: Choose the photo source and display settings. Selecting a presence entity reveals optional ON/OFF conditions for automatically enabling the LCD backlight.

data_description.device_key: Unique, stable identifier for this frame within Nextcloud Memories. Avoid renaming an existing frame unless necessary.
data_description.esp_device_id: Select the existing ESPHome device with the display. This does not install or modify ESP32 firmware.
data_description.name: Display name used for this frame in Home Assistant.
data_description.album_ids: Select one or more Nextcloud Memories albums. Their photos are combined for this frame.
data_description.width: Output image width in pixels. Match the resolution supported by your screen.
data_description.height: Output image height in pixels. Match the resolution supported by your screen.
data_description.image_format: Choose the format supported by your ESP32 display firmware: baseline JPEG or 24-bit BMP.
data_description.randomize: Shuffle photos instead of keeping the album order.
data_description.max_photos: Maximum number of photos retrieved from each selected album.
data_description.max_cache_files: Maximum number of processed image files retained in this frame's cache.
data_description.prefetch_each_side: How many previous and next photos to prepare in advance for faster navigation.
data_description.presence_entity_id: Optional presence sensor (binary_sensor or input_boolean). When ON, the backlight may turn on if all conditions below are satisfied; when OFF, the backlight always turns off. The ESPHome device needs a backlight switch.
data_description.presence_require_on_entities: Optional. With presence ON, ALL selected entities must also be ON before the backlight turns on. Unknown or unavailable states block automatic turn-on.
data_description.presence_require_off_entities: Optional. With presence ON, ALL selected entities must be OFF before the backlight turns on. These conditions never prevent turning the backlight OFF when presence ends.

error.duplicate_esp_device_id: This ESPHome device is already assigned
error.conflicting_presence_conditions: The same entity cannot be required ON and OFF
